issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Stock.add(String) as returning void, but both the template and the solution implement Stock.add(String) to return an int (the new quantity or -1). This mismatch between the specification (UML) and the provided code can confuse students about the expected method signature and return behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and code consistent. Either update the problem statement/UML to indicate +add(String): int (matching template/solution) and document the return semantics, or change the template/solution method signature to void and adapt implementations/tests accordingly. Prefer updating the UML to +add(String): int to preserve the useful return value implemented in the code.
